decision: Do not treat Deribit's XRP cross-collateral table as sufficient proof of CFM eligibility or usage.
rules: First three months from CFM's own notice commencement date: payment stablecoins, BTC and ETH only.
After that period, XRP must meet the qualifying DCO/foreign-clearing-organization route or the 26-05 fallback.
Fallback for non-security assets other than payment stablecoins requires at least 20% haircut and revised risk policies filed with MPD before acceptance.
The same-asset exception does not apply to XRP collateral for XRP-USDC linear contracts.
Keep Deribit venue haircuts (X:PM no haircut stated; X:SM 15%) separate from FCM capital charges, 26-05 fallback haircuts and account margin requirements.
Treat Deribit's qualifying foreign-clearing-organization status under the exact 26-05 jurisdiction test as unresolved until direct evidence is found.
Do not infer actual XRP collateral use from the legal route, venue listing, Coinbase integration or custody-provider inclusion.
